claim_scope: Synthetic fixture-bound evidence only; not a real-world statistical claim.
provenance: Held-out corpus for PERSON_NAME_EN (PRD S69 R5), written 2026-10-17 by a separate agent session that never saw en_person_names.json or any English name data file, the recognizer source, the tuning corpus person-en-v1.json, the bench corpus's name lists (EN_FIRST/EN_LAST), or the US SSA and Census name lists. Every name was written from general knowledge; all people are fictional except the tagged historical figures. Text is written the way users write, not shaped to the detection rules: it includes lowercase names (tag lower), particles (da, van der) and family-first order. Labels are scored as written and never edited to pass. Offsets were computed with code and every span checked against its text. Span conventions: the span is the person's name only; cues and titles (Mr, Mrs, Ms, Miss, Mx, Dr, Prof, Sir, Dame, Dear, Sayın) stay outside; a possessive or a Turkish suffix after an apostrophe stays outside (Smith's, Rivers', O’Connor’s, Miller'ın), including in capitals (HENDERSON'S); an apostrophe followed by a capital inside a name joins it (O'Brien, D'Souza); hyphenated names are one span; middle names, initials (with their dots) and lowercase particles inside a name are in the span; generational and professional suffixes (Jr., Sr., III, MD, PhD) stay outside. A single first name is positive only after a cue (Dear Rahul, Ms. Nguyen); a lone first name without a cue is negative. Institutions, streets, hospitals, schools, awards, laws, brands and products named after people are negative, as are e-mail local parts. Ties: a Turkish person name is never labelled PERSON_NAME_EN (it belongs to PERSON_NAME_TR), in Turkish, English or mixed text; Turkish-only texts are negatives. First measurement, 2026-10-17, on commit c47e728 (data file sha256 038ff492e36b58af496098eb2a1a549b5affc936b4711d7e7816cb450dd4f3f9, SSA threshold 2,000 births), by tests/gateway/privacy/test_person_corpus.py with only PERSON_NAME_EN on, exact spans: precision 0.941, recall 0.889 (160 true positives, 10 false positives, 20 false negatives). This misses the bar of 0.95 and 0.90, so PRD S69 is blocked. No change to the data or the rules followed this measurement.
